title: v2.1.323
excerpt: What's changed Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization Added engines["claude-code"] to plugin.json : plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded, and install and update pick the newest version that fits Added type checking of a plugin's TypeScript hooks module to claude plugin validate ; each finding is a warning, and --strict fails on it Added to claude plugin validate the $ nouns a mod's engine.create hook adds, withholds or replaces Added support for CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL in managed settings for Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version) Added an options menu (stop, switch to usage credits, upgrade) when a model needs usage credits that are turned off or used up Added a progress heartbeat every 30 seconds while hooks run long in claude -p and SDK sessions, so a host such as Claude Desktop won't end the turn as hung (once it includes this version) Added .docx support to Artifact tool asset uploads Added a /diff to close hint to the diff panel, and the keys that focus and close a panel to the ? shortcut guide Added a start-up warning for Bash allow rules with a * in a variable's value, such as Bash(PORT=* npm run dev) Added a warning when a plugin's language server can't start, naming the server and what to che
